item.title: Explain How to Index Old Shop Names
item.prompt_text: Your directory lists buildings by their current shop name. Older residents sometimes search for the unofficial names they heard years ago. The directory could display every old nickname or keep a hidden search list. Recommend a way to help both residents and first-time visitors and show what to do when the same nickname was used for two buildings.
item.target_grammar: Would for recommendations, when for conditions, and precise reference phrases.
item.target_structure: Explain the search problem, propose a visible result, and apply your method to a conflict.

checklist.point: Distinguish search terms from the name shown on a result.
Recommend a system that helps both kinds of user.
Explain how to resolve a nickname used for two buildings.
Describe one thing volunteers should verify.
